title: JACQUEMUS order, customer, product and pricing data platform
desc: Salesforce, ORLI/WMS, PostgreSQL and Azure SQL feed two ingestion paths: Azure Data Factory for the scheduled jobs, and Quarkus web services for data that cannot wait for a refresh window. Both land a medallion lakehouse on Azure Fabric, transformed with Apache Spark, which serves the analytics, logistics, e-commerce reporting and inventory teams. Datadog APM instruments the ingestion side and the lakehouse alike.
caption: Refresh runs from 10 minutes to daily, on ingestion payloads reaching 150 MB.

title: Ausgrid smart-meter anomaly detection pipeline
desc: Smart-meter time-series is ingested at 30-minute intervals, hashed into a blockchain audit trail so a reading cannot be altered without evidence, then passed to an unsupervised anomaly engine whose output is grid anomaly alerts for power theft and sensor faults.
caption: 300 residential solar and grid feeds, at 30-minute intervals.
